workflow: Genuine PolyPDF OCR run on an image-only public-domain scan, saved to disk, followed by exact app process teardown, a fresh app process, reopening the saved PDF, and a text search with a selected on-page hit

source.description: Image-only derivative of page 6 of a scanned U.S. government NACA report showing the U.S.S. Akron model and engineering figures.
source.rights: NASA NTRS marks the source Public and states: Work of the US Government. Public Use Permitted.

verifiedExtractedPhrases: REPORT NATIONAL ADVISORY COMMITTEE FOR AERONAUTICS
result.footerBadge: OCR completed — searchable text was added to 1 page.

caveats: PolyPDF describes OCR as best-effort; this evidence does not claim perfect transcription.
The scan's small italic labels and dimension notation produce visible recognition errors in extracted text.

The run reported that the recognized arrow and less-than-or-equal symbols remain searchable and copyable but have approximate invisible-layer positioning because the text-layer font lacks those glyphs.

screenshots.claim: Before OCR, a search for SURFACE in the image-only public-domain engineering scan returns No matches.
The genuine OCR dialog reaches OCR complete at 100%, and the footer shows the OCR badge.
After saving, exact process teardown, and reopening in a new process, SURFACE returns three results; a selected sidebar result and yellow on-page highlight prove recognized searchable text.
